visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A charismatic person with short, dark hair and glasses, styled as a corporate 'boss,' wears a long, glossy black leather trench coat and matching gloves. They are positioned in an expansive, modern urban plaza surrounded by massive glass and steel skyscrapers under a clear sky. The lighting is bright natural daylight. The character gestures expansively towards the camera with a confident facial expression, establishing a high-energy tone. (2) The scene shifts to the plaza ground level near a 7-Eleven convenience store. The main character invites various office workers—men in blazers and women in professional attire—to sit on a black lumbar support cushion placed atop a standard office chair. Brightly colored variety-show style text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear frequently around the center of the frame, highlighting posture issues like 'slumping' or 'back pain.' (3) The setting transitions to a brightly lit indoor studio with a clean white background. A woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a white puff-sleeve dress and silver flats, takes over as the presenter. She demonstrates the ergonomic benefits of the 'Style' cushion by sitting on it while it is placed on a simple wooden chair. The lighting is flat and professional, characteristic of a commercial product shoot. (4) A series of product-focused close-ups and graphic overlays are shown. The camera zooms in on three distinct models: a navy blue 'SMART' cushion, a sleek black 'PREMIUM' cushion with double padding, and a deep purple velvet-textured 'ELEGANT' cushion. Hands are shown pressing into the materials to demonstrate their elasticity and softness. Split-screen 'Before' and 'After' graphics illustrate the spinal alignment benefits. (5) The presenter demonstrates various full-sized ergonomic chairs, including the 'Chair PM' and 'Chair PMC.' She is seen sitting in a grey, more casual 'Chair DC' model in a room decorated with bookshelves and minimalist decor. A playful interaction occurs with a man wearing an 'Anonymous' mask, who appears to be relaxing comfortably in the chair while playful variety-style text captions appear. (6) The original character in the black leather coat returns, this time in a busy office environment with cubicles, computers, and fluorescent lighting. They carry a large 'Style' cushion and present it to an office worker sitting at a desk. The final shot features a vibrant graphic with social media handles and a call to action to visit the brand's Facebook page for a trial.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 beat and bright synth melodies. A male voice with a sharp, fast-paced delivery and high pitch variability introduces the 'Boss Chiang' character. The acoustic environment sounds like a processed field recording with minimal urban noise, focusing heavily on the vocal clarity and music. (2) A loud, synthesized 'boom' and 'impact' sound effect marks a transition. The audio features a mix of the main narrator's high-arousal speech and shorter, conversational responses from multiple interviewees. Frequent 'cartoon-style' sound effects, such as dings, whooshes, and comical 'boing' sounds, are edited in to punctuate the text overlays on screen. The BGM continues steadily in the background. (3) The acoustic space shifts to a deadened studio environment as a female narrator speaks with a friendly, professional, and highly articulated tone. Her speech rate is moderate, and she uses a rising intonation to sound inviting. The music track swells slightly in volume but remains secondary to the clear, broadcast-quality voiceover. (4) Technical sound design becomes prominent as the female presenter describes different product models. Each time a new model name (SMART, PREMIUM, ELEGANT) is mentioned, a 'sparkle' or 'digital UI' sound effect triggers. The spectral brightness of the audio is high, emphasizing the crispness of the sound effects and the clarity of the musical transients. (5) A humorous 'record scratch' or 'tape stop' effect creates a brief moment of strategic silence before a funny interaction in the demo room. This is followed by a layered mix of the female narrator's energetic closing statements and a final surge in the BGM volume. The audio ends with a clean logo stinger and a final authoritative call to action from the lead male narrator.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Style' brand of Japanese spinal health cushions and ergonomic chairs by utilizing a high-energy 'Boss' persona and a professional presenter to highlight features like posture correction and comfort for office workers.
